title: Meta has pulled out of a renewable energy initiative as it relies more on natural gas for data centers - Engadget
summary: The company has comitted to 10 natural gas plants since last year. As both TechCrunch and Recharge point out, funding natural gas plants doesn't necessarily mean that Meta can't still claim to be making good on renewable energy commitments.
